# Setup package fixtures

`spotto-aws-setup.json` preserves the legacy API-generated package with
`SecurityAudit` and `ReadOnlyAccess` attachments for backward compatibility tests.

`spotto-aws-setup-current.json` was copied on 2026-10-16 from
`spotto-tools/onboarding/aws/tests/fixtures/spotto-aws-setup-current.json`. It was
generated by the real API `AwsIamOnboardingBundleBuilder`, with discovery allows
inside `SpottoGuardrails` and an empty `managedPolicies` list for every role.
Its SHA-256 is `50073129135fc5d92b867f2d5ba5c1f9809728aa22bf492fa9dd2ffb1a158745`.

`generate-fixture.ts` uses the sibling API checkout's current builder. To refresh
the current fixture without replacing the legacy package, run from `../api`:

```sh
node_modules/.bin/esbuild ../terraform-aws-spotto/tests/fixtures/generate-fixture.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/generate-terraform-fixture.cjs
node /tmp/generate-terraform-fixture.cjs ../terraform-aws-spotto/tests/fixtures/spotto-aws-setup-current.json
```

Update the provenance and checksum here when refreshing the current fixture.
